title: Start early or save more?
viewer_line: After watching, a first-year employee can explain why ten years of saving from 25 can beat thirty years of saving from 35, and knows the one setting to change today.

beats.vo: Two friends. Same job, same salary.
beats.picture: Two simple figures side by side, identical name cards

beats.vo: Mia saves two hundred a month from twenty-five, then stops at thirty-five.
beats.picture: Mia's card grows a short bar labelled 10 years

beats.vo: Leo waits, then saves the same two hundred a month from thirty-five to sixty-five.
beats.picture: Leo's card grows a bar three times longer, labelled 30 years

beats.vo: Leo puts in three times more money. So who ends up with more?
beats.picture: Two coin stacks, Leo's towering; a question mark lands between them

beats.vo: Growth is paid on the money you already have, including last year's growth.
beats.picture: A small square splits into a slightly bigger square, which splits again
beats.seam: carry: the squares become a curve

beats.vo: At seven percent a year, money roughly doubles every ten years.
beats.picture: A curve with three marked doubling steps
beats.art: <svg viewBox='0 0 400 220' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><path d='M20 200 C150 195 260 160 380 30' fill='none' stroke='#f5b041' stroke-width='6'/><g fill='#f3efe6' font-size='16' font-family='sans-serif'><circle cx='140' cy='190' r='6'/><text x='122' y='176'>×2</text><circle cx='260' cy='150' r='6'/><text x='242' y='136'>×4</text><circle cx='360' cy='60' r='6'/><text x='334' y='48'>×8</text></g></svg>

beats.vo: Mia's dollars get about twenty more years to grow. That is two extra doublings.
beats.picture: Mia's small stack doubles twice more on a timeline while Leo's is still being filled

beats.vo: At sixty-five, assuming seven percent a year, Mia has about two hundred and eighty thousand.
beats.picture: Mia's stack rises past the line where Leo's will stop
beats.seam: carry: Leo's stack rises next to it

beats.vo: Leo, with three times the deposits, has about two hundred and forty-four thousand.
beats.picture: Leo's stack stops just short of Mia's

beats.vo: The years did more work than the extra deposits.
beats.picture: Bold line of type, alone on screen

beats.vo: So today, switch on automatic saving, even if it is small.
beats.picture: A toggle in a banking app slides to ON
